payout_quote: There's no limit to how many referrals you can make and no limit to how much you could earn! Earn $100 when you refer someone and they become a member - then we'll give them $100 too! ... $100 bonus will be credited to checking within 90 days of account opening, provided all requirements are met.
steps: Be a Financial Partners Credit Union member 18+ with an active savings account, checking account, and/or loan; get your referral code from the '$100 for you & $100 for them' email or contact FPCU.
Your friend applies for membership using your referral code at time of application (friend must be 18+, not a current member, and not have been a member during the previous 12 months).

The friend opens and maintains a new FPCU savings account with at least $25, maintains an active checking account and/or loan, receives a monthly direct deposit of at least $500, and makes $300+ in FPCU debit card purchases within 60 days of account opening.
You receive $100 credited to your checking within 90 days of account opening (your friend also gets $100); both accounts must be in good standing.
catches: The friend's bar is high: $500/month direct deposit AND $300 in debit purchases within 60 days, plus an active checking account or loan - a savings-only membership won't pay.
The referral code must be entered at time of application - retroactive credit is not possible.
Referred member cannot be a current member or have been a member during the previous 12 months.
FPCU employees, volunteers, business accounts, and fiduciary accounts are ineligible.
Bonus reported as interest income to the IRS; offer can be terminated at any time without notice.
biggest_catch: Your friend needs a real $500/month direct deposit plus $300 in debit spending within 60 days - and your referral code has to be on their application from the start.
eligibility: FPCU members 18+ with active savings, checking, and/or loan. Referred persons 18+, membership-eligible, not current members and not members in the previous 12 months.
timing: $100 bonus credited to checking within 90 days of account opening, provided all requirements are met.
